candidate_sentences.text: The Group achieved revenue of EUR 59.3 million, representing a 2.4% growth compared to EUR 57.9 million in the same period of the previous year.

verified_key_information_units.information: Operational volumes declined significantly: cargo handling fell 5.0% to 6.5 million tonnes (mainly due to liquid bulk down 33.8%), passengers decreased 2.0% to 3.6 million (with the Tallinn–Helsinki route down 2.6%), and vessel calls dropped 4.8%.

In passenger transport, total passenger numbers declined by 2.0% to 3.59 million.

While cruise passenger traffic surged by nearly 48% due to increased ship calls, this growth was offset by a decrease in traditional ferry passengers, particularly on the Tallinn–Helsinki route where volumes fell by 2.6%, impacted by a scheduled vessel dry-docking and a high baseline from major music events in the prior year.
